Fact: data_provenance
What to find: Provenance categories of training data (web crawl, licensed/third-party private, user data, public datasets, synthetic, other).

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Public datasets: trained on publicly available third party datasets (referenced in the technical report and the Molmo2 data collection of curated image-text and video-text pairs); these third party datasets are subject to academic and non-commercial research use only.
quotes:
Molmo2 models are trained on publicly available third party datasets as referenced in [our technical report](https://allenai.org/papers/molmo2) and [Molmo2 data](https://huggingface.co/collections/allenai/molmo2-data), 
a collection of datasets with highly-curated image-text and video-text pairs.
This model is trained on third party datasets that are subject to academic and non-commercial research use only.
